title.zh: Morning Minute: Clarity Act Vote Falls Short as Democrats All Vote ‘No’
title.en: Morning Minute: Clarity Act Vote Falls Short as Democrats All Vote ‘No’

current_state.zh: The Senate rejected cloture on the Clarity Act 49-50, falling 11 votes short of the 60-vote threshold as all Democrats voted no, triggering a broad crypto market selloff with Bitcoin dropping 4% to $75,960.
